source_text: Lemma Luke 2:21-24. (Jerome Latin per Rauer GCS 35; working note for condensed tip.)
pass_a_gloss: Homily 10 on Luke 2:21-24: Circumcision and presentation (Luke 2:21-24)
pass_b_english: The child is circumcised and named Jesus; they offer the poor’s pair of doves. He who gave the law submits to the law to redeem those under the law.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
